metadata.description: ennyn: a measured development loop for coding agents (one plugin).

plugins.name: ennyn
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin and Node CLI that gives the agent a working routine: impact analysis before code is written, a two-round review, and checks on every commit for recurring classes of bugs. In every session its hooks record the plugin's version in the plugin's own data folder; everything else they do only in a project with an Ennyn config (.ennyn/config.json, or the file ENNYN_CONFIG names): pass the project's path-scoped rules into worktrees and copies, and apply the conversation style you chose.
